# Code coverage

How to generate and read clang source-based coverage for chromium.

## Generating

Notes for generating are still being expanded; this is a placeholder paragraph used by the chromium-atlas mock fixture set so that the title-list view always has descriptive copy to render.

```sh
tools/code_coverage/coverage.py components_unittests -b out/Coverage
```
